title: On-Time Guarantee Schedule by Service Level (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
Cartwise Grocery Orders on-time guarantee: which fee each service level returns when an order completes late, how late counts as late, and how many such returns a customer may receive in a rolling 30 days.

| Service level | Fee covered by the on-time guarantee | Minutes after the window end beyond which the order counts as late | Guarantee refunds per customer in a rolling 30 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | the pickup fee | 15 | 2 |
| No-Rush Delivery | none (no fee is covered) | 60 | 2 |
| Standard Delivery | the delivery fee | 15 | 2 |
| Priority Delivery | the Priority surcharge | 10 | 2 |
| Express 30 Delivery | the Express 30 surcharge | 15 | 2 |
| Stock-Up Delivery | the delivery fee | 30 | 2 |

**Scope values.** The covered fee is one of: none, the pickup fee, the delivery fee, the Priority surcharge or the Express 30 surcharge. No-Rush Delivery is the one service level whose scope is none.

**Late threshold.** The figure is a number of minutes counted after the end of the booked window.

**Rolling allowance.** The figure is the number of on-time guarantee refunds one customer may receive across a rolling 30 days; it is 2 at every Cartwise Grocery Orders service level.

**Hypothetical timings against the threshold**

| Hypothetical order | Window end | Completed at | Minutes after window end | Past the threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Priority Delivery | 18:00 | 18:10 | 10 | no — 10 is not more than 10 |
| Priority Delivery | 18:00 | 18:11 | 11 | yes |
| Stock-Up Delivery | 18:00 | 18:25 | 25 | no — the threshold is 30 |
